limitations: The screen filters only trades that filled in rejected reports. It does not rerun the candidate path or account state.
Per-symbol reports use isolated research wallets and do not establish a shared-wallet portfolio domain.
A filtered result cannot qualify a strategy or authorize a change to live exits.
Trades retain the original 0.5 percent research sizing policy; the selected 0.25 percent live policy is not tested here.
measurement: Favorable close-to-entry displacement on the exact 1m signal candle, divided by trailing 14-bar true-range mean.
